brief: Wildfires force mass evacuations in Europe, while Houthi attacks escalate tensions with Saudi Arabia; new AI tools explore creative and clinical applications.
news_summary: Wildfires in France and Spain force over 300,000 evacuations, and Houthi attacks corner Saudi Arabia into potential new conflict; US legal news includes Kohberger's plea reversal and dismissed charges against a union leader.
papers_summary: Research on diffusion models for artistic AI, virtual patients for medical training, and visual analytics for molecular GNNs highlight human-centered AI advances.

zh.brief: 今日焦点包括香港前议员胡志伟在英被扣后获准逗留，所罗门群岛中资金矿坍塌致多人死亡，以及中国女童基因编辑治疗死亡引发争议。学术方面多篇研究关注AI在创意与医疗中的应用。
zh.news_summary: 香港前议员胡志伟赴英被扣后获准逗留，否认申请政治庇护；所罗门中资金矿坍塌至少10人死亡，凸显资源治理困境；中国女童基因编辑治疗死亡引发调查。
zh.papers_summary: 多篇arXiv论文探讨AI在艺术创作（如扩散模型交互修改）和医疗沟通培训（如虚拟病人）中的应用，以及可视化工具的可解释性与伦理设计。

todays_image.caption: The aster-like flower's delicate, star-shaped blooms evoke a tragic contrast to the wall of flames that turned landscapes into ash and fear.
todays_image.title: Chaetopappa asteroides (Nutt.) DC.
